name: Haruno Serina
source:
1st year high school student.
Hobbies: Gardening (Fruits and Vegetables, as well as things to use as offerings to the dead), Taking Walks

A kind person who seems calm, but she's strong at the core and hates giving up on things once she starts.
She has a really bad sense of direction and often gets lost.
